cohorts.accession: EGAS00000000109 (genotypes); expression ArrayExpress accession unavailable in inspected main text
cohorts.intervention: LPS 20 ng/mL, 2 or 24 h; IFNG 20 ng/mL, 24 h; unstimulated
cohorts.sample_count: 414 unstimulated; 367 IFNG; 322 24-h LPS; 261 2-h LPS; 228 donors shared across all four states
cohorts.notes: Fairfax Oxford monocyte cohort. Al-Mossawi soluble IL7R arm explicitly reuses 161 samples. Contexts and assays within this cohort are not independent donor replications; exact donor identifiers not inspected.
Reanalysis of ImmVar T-cell expression data, not a newly recruited 178-person cohort. Potential donor overlap with ImmVar/PhenoGenetic Lee G09 unresolved.

cohorts.sample_count: at least two independent experiments reported
cohorts.notes: Engineered reporter system, not independent human donors or native allele replacement.

cohorts.participants: C57BL/6 enhancer-edited mice and wild-type littermates
cohorts.cell_type: naive CD4+ CD62L+ CD44- T cell
cohorts.intervention: human rs61839660-equivalent SNP knock-in; anti-CD3/CD28 stimulation
cohorts.sample_count: Figure 3d SNP n=6, wild-type n=10; 12DEL n=5 not pooled into SNP comparison
cohorts.notes: Separate from NOD-background EDEL experiments and human ImmVar. Allele effect on mouse surface IL2RA is context-specific. No human disease phenotype proof.

cohorts.intervention: allele-specific IL7R splicing and DDX39B 5-prime UTR reporters; DDX39B siRNA where indicated
cohorts.sample_count: biological triplicates; knockdown experiments repeated three times
cohorts.notes: Reporter experiments share laboratory system. GSE94730 belongs to RNA-seq experiments in this paper, not asserted to identify these reporter wells.

cohorts.intervention: anti-CD3/CD28 activation; DDX39B sh3/sh5 knockdown; IL2 culture then withdrawal before collection
cohorts.notes: Healthy donors stratified as IL7R rs6897932 CC or CT; no TT donor comparison. Individual donor samples are repeated across shRNA conditions.

cohorts.ancestry: Yoruba/Esan in Nigeria (YRI/ESN), 25; Iberian in Spain (IBS), 27
cohorts.notes: Figure 3 experimental LCL panel, distinct per authors from earlier Wu 2013 YRI/CEU proteomics dataset. Within-panel genotype counts: African CC12/AC11/AA2; Iberian CC12/AC12/AA3. Do not merge with historical CEU null result as one population.

cohorts.disease: relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis and healthy controls
cohorts.notes: Figure 3B counts CC32/AC31/AA23. Case/control split and ancestry not recovered. Not the six-cohort MS association meta-analysis.

cohorts.cell_type: 13 purified immune cell types plus activated naive CD4/CD8 T cells
cohorts.intervention: ex vivo profiling; T-cell activation in separate conditions
cohorts.sample_count: 106 leukapheresis collections including 15 longitudinal repeat collections
cohorts.notes: DICE phase 1, San Diego Blood Bank. 54 male/37 female; median age 27 (18–61). Self-reported race/ethnicity in Table S1A, not fully extracted; ancestry unavailable rather than assumed European. Same donors across 15 cell conditions.

cohorts.intervention: pre-coated anti-CD3 10 micrograms/mL; soluble anti-CD28 1 microgram/mL; IL7 5 ng/mL; surface 4-1BB flow cytometry
cohorts.notes: Figure 3K genotype-selected follow-up. Exact overlap with the 91-person DICE discovery cohort not verified; conservatively share study evidence group, not independent replication.

cohorts.cell_type: classical CD14+ CD16- monocytes; CD66b+ CD16+ neutrophils; phenotypically naive CD4+ CD45RA+ T cells
cohorts.notes: BLUEPRINT human variation panel: 169/200 recruited donors extended to naive T cells; 54% female, mean age 55. UK blood-donor population. Genetic PCA European-ancestry criterion shown in Figure S2; exact retained ancestry breakdown not verified, so ancestry unavailable. Other BLUEPRINT publications are potential reuse, not new donors.

cohorts.intervention: single-cell RNA-seq; no stimulation stated in abstract
cohorts.notes: OneK1K original cohort. GSE196830 identified in later primary-source data availability, but not independently checked against original deposition here. Ancestry/age/sex unavailable from inspected original abstract. Later OneK1K reuse is not independent evidence.

cohorts.cell_type: naive and memory CD4+ T cells
cohorts.intervention: anti-CD3/CD28 Dynabeads 1:2 bead:cell ratio; 16 h, 40 h, 5 d; negative controls cultured 16 h without beads
cohorts.notes: 67 male/52 female, mean age 47, SD15.61. Author-reported sex percentages (53.7%/56.3%) are inconsistent with counts and are not propagated. Donors modeled as repeated measures; subclusters are not independent cohorts. Cell culture time of resting comparator is not zero elapsed time.

cohorts.participants: four family-based or case-control datasets; sizes unavailable
cohorts.notes: Authors describe four independent datasets within paper; individual cohort identities and overlap with later MS studies unresolved. Do not infer four independent weights from this abstract.

cohorts.ancestry: 295 Caucasians, 122 African-Americans, 117 East Asians (original study labels)
cohorts.intervention: LPS, influenza infection, IFNB stimulation, or resting
cohorts.sample_count: 1598 transcriptional profiles; preliminary microarray panel 30 donors
cohorts.notes: PhenoGenetic/ImmVar-associated study. Disease-locus example Figure 6A uses 184 Caucasians (author wording). Cell differentiation is ex vivo; no direct extrapolation to tissue-resident DC. Discovery-panel overlap with 534 and overlap with GCO02 unresolved.

cohorts.ancestry: European (inherited only from explicitly reused GCO01 cohort)
cohorts.intervention: LPS 20 ng/mL for 24 h; supernatant ELISA
cohorts.notes: Figure 3a and Results explicitly identify randomly selected samples from previous eQTL study. Known reuse; exact donor matching not available. Must share biological independence group with GCO01.

Figure 2e genotyped TNF arm; larger paper also has isolated-monocyte n84 and other PBMC panels. Do not sum panels as independent donors; overlap among panels and with original Fairfax cohort unresolved.

assertions.subject: rs1179625
assertions.source_locator: Figure 1C; Results: Identifying Context-Specific Local Genetic Regulatory Variants
assertions.evidence_summary: The peak rs1179625 association with HIP1 RNA has opposite directions in unstimulated monocytes and after 24-hour LPS.
assertions.assay: Illumina HumanHT-12 v4 expression microarray; HumanOmniExpress genotyping
assertions.uncertainty: Effect estimate and confidence interval unavailable unless explicitly supplied; cohort/state-specific evidence.
assertions.causal_directness: Genotype association with molecular trait; linked variants and residual confounding remain possible.
assertions.limitations: No automatic transport across cell type, stimulation, ancestry, tissue or molecular layer.

assertions.subject: rs7700004 T allele
assertions.source_locator: Figure 1B
assertions.evidence_summary: After IFNG treatment, T-allele carriers show greater STAP1 induction than C-allele carriers.
assertions.uncertainty: Effect estimate and confidence interval unavailable unless explicitly supplied; cohort/state-specific evidence.
assertions.causal_directness: Genotype association with molecular trait; linked variants and residual confounding remain possible.
assertions.limitations: No automatic transport across cell type, stimulation, ancestry, tissue or molecular layer.

assertions.subject: rs7131225
assertions.source_locator: Figure 1B
assertions.evidence_summary: The GDPD5 eQTL detected in untreated monocytes was no longer detected after IFNG-induced expression.
assertions.uncertainty: Effect estimate and confidence interval unavailable unless explicitly supplied; cohort/state-specific evidence.
assertions.causal_directness: Genotype association with molecular trait; linked variants and residual confounding remain possible.
assertions.limitations: Failure to detect is not equivalence or proof of zero effect; power and induction-dependent variance may differ.

assertions.subject: cis genetic variation at TNF
assertions.source_locator: Figure 1D; Results: Identifying Context-Specific Local Genetic Regulatory Variants
assertions.evidence_summary: A TNF RNA eQTL is detected after 24-hour LPS but not during the 2-hour induction phase.
assertions.uncertainty: Effect estimate and confidence interval unavailable unless explicitly supplied; cohort/state-specific evidence.
assertions.causal_directness: Genotype association with molecular trait; linked variants and residual confounding remain possible.
assertions.limitations: Lead variant not extracted; this locus-level assertion must not become a named causal-variant edge. RNA does not measure TNF secretion.

assertions.subject: rs61839660 alternate allele in CaRE4
assertions.source_locator: Figure 2c,d; Methods: Luciferase assays
assertions.evidence_summary: Introducing rs61839660 into CaRE4 reduces the stimulation-dependent reporter signal relative to reference sequence in Jurkat cells.
assertions.uncertainty: Effect estimate and confidence interval unavailable unless explicitly supplied; cohort/state-specific evidence.
assertions.causal_directness: Direct allele manipulation establishes an effect in the reporter assay; G4 is restricted to that assay.
assertions.limitations: Reporter enzymatic signal is a regulatory readout, not measured endogenous IL2RA RNA or cytokine responsiveness. No native human allele replacement.

assertions.subject: rs61839660 minor allele
assertions.source_locator: Figure 2e and Extended Data Figure 6
assertions.evidence_summary: The minor allele associates with reduced IL2RA transcript after CD3/CD28 stimulation, including analysis conditioned on rs2476491.
assertions.uncertainty: Effect estimate and confidence interval unavailable unless explicitly supplied; cohort/state-specific evidence.
assertions.causal_directness: Genotype association with molecular trait; linked variants and residual confounding remain possible.
assertions.limitations: Association remains G2 despite supporting reporter/mouse experiments elsewhere; ImmVar donor reuse unresolved.

assertions.subject: rs61839660-equivalent SNP knock-in
assertions.source_locator: Figure 3c,d
assertions.evidence_summary: Naive T cells from SNP knock-in mice have reduced surface IL2RA 24 hours after CD3/CD28 activation.
assertions.cell_type: naive CD4+ CD62L+ CD44- T cell
assertions.assay: CRISPR knock-in followed by flow cytometry
assertions.genomic_background: C57BL/6; homozygous SNP knock-in versus wild-type littermates
assertions.uncertainty: Reported P <= 0.0001; Figure 3d SNP n=6 and wild-type n=10; no confidence interval extracted.
assertions.causal_directness: Direct allele editing in mice; effect applies to measured mouse surface abundance.
assertions.limitations: Separate from human evidence and from NOD EDEL deletion experiments. Not complete loss of receptor, signaling assay or proof of human autoimmunity.

assertions.subject: rs6897932 C allele
assertions.source_locator: Figure 5; Methods: DDX39B RNAi-mediated knockdown and rescue
assertions.evidence_summary: Under DDX39B depletion, the IL7R-C minigene shows more exon 6 skipping than the IL7R-T minigene.
assertions.duration: siRNA on days 1/3; reporter day 5; RNA day 7
assertions.genomic_background: HeLa; reporter C versus T at rs6897932
assertions.uncertainty: Effect estimate and confidence interval unavailable unless explicitly supplied; cohort/state-specific evidence.
assertions.causal_directness: Direct reporter allele manipulation with trans-factor depletion; assay-specific causal effect.
assertions.limitations: HeLa reporter context does not establish the same effect size in unstimulated primary immune cells.

assertions.subject: rs2523506 A allele
assertions.source_locator: Figure 4A,B; Results: rs2523506 controls translation efficiency
assertions.evidence_summary: A-allele DDX39B 5-prime UTR reporters have lower luciferase activity per RNA than C-allele reporters.
assertions.assay: dual luciferase activity divided by reporter RNA quantified by RT-qPCR
assertions.uncertainty: Effect estimate and confidence interval unavailable unless explicitly supplied; cohort/state-specific evidence.
assertions.causal_directness: Direct UTR allele manipulation tests a translation readout in HeLa cells.
assertions.limitations: Not a direct endogenous DDX39B protein measurement or native allele edit. Does not imply an eQTL for RNA abundance.

assertions.subject: rs2523506
assertions.source_locator: Figure 3B left
assertions.evidence_summary: DDX39B RNA levels do not differ detectably by rs2523506 genotype in the PBMC panel.
assertions.disease: relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis and healthy controls
assertions.uncertainty: 86 donors; genotype groups CC32, AC31, AA23; no equivalence interval reported.
assertions.causal_directness: Genotype association with molecular trait; linked variants and residual confounding remain possible.
assertions.limitations: Candidate association null, not genome-wide eQTL mapping. Case/control composition and treatment context unresolved. RNA null cannot negate the separate protein/readout evidence.

assertions.subject: DDX39B
assertions.source_locator: Figure 6; Results: DDX39B regulates IL7R exon 6 inclusion in primary CD4+ T cells
assertions.evidence_summary: Two DDX39B shRNAs increase IL7R exon 6 skipping in activated primary CD4 T cells from six donors.
assertions.stimulation: anti-CD3/CD28 activation followed by DDX39B shRNA
assertions.dose: activation anti-CD3 50 ng/mL and anti-CD28 100 ng/mL; culture IL2 100 ng/mL
assertions.duration: 48 h preactivation; 72 h transduction; 96 h selection; 24 h without IL2/puromycin before collection
assertions.assay: lentiviral shRNA; RT-PCR; DDX39B western blot
assertions.uncertainty: Effect estimate and confidence interval unavailable unless explicitly supplied; cohort/state-specific evidence.
assertions.causal_directness: Trans-factor depletion in primary cells; does not directly edit rs2523506.
assertions.limitations: Six donors; differential knockdown efficiency; genotype groups small. No TT group. Gene depletion is not a causal variant experiment.

assertions.subject: DDX39B
assertions.source_locator: Results accompanying Figure 6; Figure S10
assertions.evidence_summary: Supernatant IL7R increases in all six donors with sh3, but only two donors with sh5 despite splicing changes.
assertions.stimulation: DDX39B shRNA in previously CD3/CD28-activated T cells
assertions.duration: 24-h collection without IL2 and puromycin after knockdown/selection
assertions.uncertainty: Effect estimate and confidence interval unavailable unless explicitly supplied; cohort/state-specific evidence.
assertions.causal_directness: Primary-cell depletion; inconsistent reagent-specific protein output.
assertions.limitations: Authors state ELISA antibody can detect all IL7R isoforms; unexplained sh5 discordance. Do not infer uniform secretion change from exon skipping.

assertions.subject: rs2511162 A/A genotype
assertions.source_locator: Figure 3G and Results: Expression QTLs are highly cell-specific
assertions.evidence_summary: The A/A genotype associates with lower GAB2 RNA in B cells.
assertions.uncertainty: Effect estimate and confidence interval unavailable unless explicitly supplied; cohort/state-specific evidence.
assertions.causal_directness: Genotype association with molecular trait; linked variants and residual confounding remain possible.
assertions.limitations: No automatic transport across cell type, stimulation, ancestry, tissue or molecular layer.

assertions.subject: rs2511162 A/A genotype
assertions.source_locator: Figure 3G and Results: Expression QTLs are highly cell-specific
assertions.evidence_summary: The same A/A genotype associates with higher GAB2 RNA in T cells.
assertions.uncertainty: Effect estimate and confidence interval unavailable unless explicitly supplied; cohort/state-specific evidence.
assertions.causal_directness: Genotype association with molecular trait; linked variants and residual confounding remain possible.
assertions.limitations: Do not turn opposing cell-type associations into a uniform regulatory prior. Exact T-cell subset coefficients not extracted.

assertions.subject: rs9657975 T/T genotype
assertions.source_locator: Figure 3K; Figure S2F
assertions.evidence_summary: After activation, T/T donors have a greater fraction of surface 4-1BB-positive CD4 T cells than C/C donors.
assertions.stimulation: pre-coated anti-CD3; soluble anti-CD28; IL7 co-stimulation
assertions.dose: anti-CD3 10 micrograms/mL; anti-CD28 1 microgram/mL; IL7 5 ng/mL
assertions.uncertainty: Effect estimate and confidence interval unavailable unless explicitly supplied; cohort/state-specific evidence.
assertions.causal_directness: Candidate genotype–protein association follow-up, not direct allele manipulation.
assertions.limitations: Other activation markers CD69/CD25/HLA-DR did not share the effect. Protein validation does not establish signaling, clinical response or causal variant localization.

assertions.subject: rs1800693-associated MS signal
assertions.source_locator: Results: Molecular QTLs Colocalize with Disease-Predisposing Variants; Figure 7 and Table S5
assertions.evidence_summary: The multiple-sclerosis signal at rs1800693 colocalizes with TNFRSF1A alternative splicing in monocytes and neutrophils.
assertions.assay: RNA-seq sQTL mapping and disease-QTL colocalization
assertions.uncertainty: Effect estimate and confidence interval unavailable unless explicitly supplied; cohort/state-specific evidence.
assertions.causal_directness: Statistical support for a shared locus mechanism; no allele perturbation in this assertion.
assertions.limitations: Colocalization is model-dependent; exact event coordinates, allele direction and posterior not extracted. Does not prove secretion of a soluble TNFRSF1A isoform.

assertions.subject: rs3807306
assertions.source_locator: Figure 4E (ISO sQTL examples)
assertions.evidence_summary: rs3807306 associates with a switch between two major IRF5 isoforms with different 5-prime UTRs in neutrophils.
assertions.uncertainty: Effect estimate and confidence interval unavailable unless explicitly supplied; cohort/state-specific evidence.
assertions.causal_directness: Genotype association with molecular trait; linked variants and residual confounding remain possible.
assertions.limitations: Isoform association without direct allele perturbation. No transcription-factor protein activity inferred.

assertions.subject: cis genetic variation at VAMP8
assertions.source_locator: Results: eQTL mapping in CD4+ T cell populations; Figure 2g
assertions.evidence_summary: A VAMP8 eQTL is detected in central-memory CD4 T-cell subpopulations, while absent in the inspected DICE T-cell comparison.
assertions.duration: study spans resting control, 16 h, 40 h and 5 d; exact VAMP8 subcluster time unavailable
assertions.assay: single-cell RNA-seq aggregated per donor/cluster; tensorQTL
assertions.uncertainty: Reported TCM-specific adjusted P=5e-4; lead SNP and effect size not extracted.
assertions.causal_directness: Genotype association with molecular trait; linked variants and residual confounding remain possible.
assertions.limitations: Molecule-specific QTL target supported, but lead variant unavailable. DICE nondetection may reflect power/annotation differences and is not proof of biological absence. No materialized variant path.

assertions.subject: cis genetic variation at AIMP1
assertions.source_locator: Results: eQTL mapping in CD4+ T cell populations
assertions.evidence_summary: An AIMP1 eQTL is detected in central-memory CD4 T-cell subpopulations and was not detected in the inspected DICE T-cell comparison.
assertions.duration: study spans resting control, 16 h, 40 h and 5 d; exact AIMP1 subcluster time unavailable
assertions.assay: single-cell RNA-seq aggregated per donor/cluster; tensorQTL
assertions.uncertainty: Reported TCM-specific adjusted P=1.04e-4; lead SNP and effect size not extracted.
assertions.causal_directness: Genotype association with molecular trait; linked variants and residual confounding remain possible.
assertions.limitations: Lead variant unavailable; no variant-specific prior or signaling-function inference. DICE comparison differs in cell definitions and power.

assertions.subject: rs6897932
assertions.source_locator: PubMed abstract, association and variant sentences
assertions.evidence_summary: IL7R polymorphism rs6897932 is associated with multiple sclerosis across four datasets in the original report.
assertions.uncertainty: Overall P=2.9e-7; effect size and confidence interval unavailable in abstract.
assertions.causal_directness: Disease association; does not itself establish molecular or disease causality.
assertions.limitations: Abstract-only extraction. Cohort membership, sample sizes and allele effects require full-text verification; four publications/datasets are not automatically four independent prior increments.

assertions.subject: rs4963128
assertions.source_locator: Figure 6A and Results: Linking reQTLs to human disease
assertions.evidence_summary: rs4963128 associates with IRF7 expression after IFNB stimulation but is not detected as an association at baseline.
assertions.uncertainty: Stimulated P=1.10e-16; effect size unavailable.
assertions.causal_directness: Genotype association with molecular trait; linked variants and residual confounding remain possible.
assertions.limitations: SLE-associated SNP is not proven causal by this eQTL; baseline nondetection is not an equivalence test.

assertions.subject: rs12805435
assertions.source_locator: Figure 5B; Results on trans associations; Tables S8–S10
assertions.evidence_summary: rs12805435 associates in trans with IFNA13 expression and induction after influenza infection; the trans effect is stimulus-specific.
assertions.ancestry: 295 Caucasians, 122 African-Americans, 117 East Asians (original study labels)
assertions.duration: 10 h infection time used in study response design
assertions.uncertainty: Effect estimate and confidence interval unavailable unless explicitly supplied; cohort/state-specific evidence.
assertions.causal_directness: Trans molecular association; separate IRF7 overexpression is supportive but does not edit this variant.
assertions.limitations: Restricted 415-gene signature and trans-testing strategy; IFNA13 RNA is not secreted IFN-alpha protein or antiviral phenotype.

assertions.subject: rs6897932 C risk allele
assertions.source_locator: Figure 2e; Results: rs6897932 regulates monocyte cell surface IL7R levels
assertions.evidence_summary: After TNF stimulation, the disease-risk allele associates with lower mean monocyte surface IL7R.
assertions.uncertainty: P=0.0007, ANOVA; n=62; numeric effect unavailable.
assertions.causal_directness: Genotype association with molecular trait; linked variants and residual confounding remain possible.
assertions.limitations: PBMC-gated monocytes, not purified-cell intrinsic effect proof. TNF context differs from the LPS soluble-protein arm. No direct measurement of receptor signaling.

assertions.subject: rs6897932 C allele
assertions.source_locator: Figure 3a; Results: sIL7R is regulated by rs6897932
assertions.evidence_summary: CC donors have higher soluble IL7R in monocyte supernatants than TT donors after 24-hour LPS.
assertions.ancestry: European (inherited only from explicitly reused GCO01 cohort)
assertions.assay: supernatant sandwich ELISA; CD127 polyclonal antibodies, Fc-chimera standard
assertions.uncertainty: Allelic P=4.7e-15; n=161. Published absolute concentration units need source-data verification and are not used as an effect-size prior.
assertions.causal_directness: Genotype association with molecular trait; linked variants and residual confounding remain possible.
assertions.limitations: Known donor reuse from G01. ELISA does not independently identify splice origin versus all extracellular isoforms or prove IL7 availability/activity.

assertions.subject: rs2523506 by rs6897932 genotype interaction
assertions.source_locator: Results after Figure 3; Supplementary Figure 6
assertions.evidence_summary: The reported DDX39B–IL7R genetic interaction is not detected for soluble IL7R in LPS-stimulated monocytes.
assertions.ancestry: European (inherited only from explicitly reused GCO01 cohort)
assertions.assay: supernatant ELISA with candidate genotype interaction analysis
assertions.uncertainty: Effect estimate and confidence interval unavailable unless explicitly supplied; cohort/state-specific evidence.
assertions.causal_directness: Candidate interaction test, not a direct perturbation of either allele.
assertions.limitations: Minor-allele frequency limits power. Monocyte LPS context differs from HeLa reporter and activated CD4 T-cell experiments; this null does not refute their context-specific effects.

gaps.description: This is a purposive 10-publication pilot, not exhaustive systematic search. No independent database-wide screening, full inclusion/exclusion ledger, full citation chaining, or search saturation is claimed.

OneK1K is abstract-level and contributes cohort/source context only. Obtain full methods, ancestry and variant-level summary statistics before any molecule-specific assertions or causal-MR interpretation.

The 2018 IL2RA author correction is confirmed; indexed excerpt indicates altered EDEL Treg percentages after genotype correction/paired analysis. Correction full text is not obtained. Original EDEL steady-state phenotype statement is not imported.

Cohort independence remains unresolved for ImmVar/PhenoGenetic reuse, DICE protein follow-up, BLUEPRINT secondary analyses and MS association cohorts. Explicit G10→G01 subset reuse must be enforced in weighting.

DICE ancestry distribution, individual BLUEPRINT ancestry filtering, and complete dose/time metadata in ImmVar/Lee still need supplementary extraction. Soskic reported sex percentages conflict with counts; retain counts without erroneous percentages.
Lead variants and event coordinates missing for VAMP8, AIMP1, TNF and TNFRSF1A event descriptions. These are target/event-level evidence records, not fully identified variant-specific prior inputs.

HLA/KIR, structural variation, somatic variants, ancestry-diverse immune QTL atlases, pQTL colocalization, cytokine-QTL dose-response and tissue-resident immune regulation are not systematically covered.

Recent indexed candidates require next-round screening: Genome-scale mapping of variant, enhancer and gene function in primary human CD4+ T cells (PMC13060838); Cell-type-specific eQTLs underlie the genetic architecture of complex traits (10.1038/s41586-026-10577-6); single-cell splicing study (10.1038/s41588-024-02019-8). No results are asserted without primary extraction; later OneK1K reuse must not count as independent replication.

Published absolute soluble IL7R concentrations in G10 may require unit verification against source data and assay calibration. They are intentionally not numeric magnitude priors; qualitative direction and reported association P are retained.

No source-to-target cytokine pathway is proven by these genomic assertions. Reporter, transformed-line, primary-cell, resting/stimulated, timepoint, RNA/protein and species contexts must pass compatibility checks before assembly.

synthesis: Genomic evidence is state- and modality-dependent. Stimulated eQTLs, direction reversals, splicing effects and separately measured surface or supernatant proteins support context-specific priors. Direct allele reporter effects and mouse edits are retained at their actual assay/species level; human molecular QTLs remain statistical evidence. Nulls and reagent discordance remain visible. Ten primary sources form a bounded pilot; OneK1K provides an evaluated atlas anchor without invented molecule-level edges. No disease-causal complete path or calibrated probability is claimed.
